name: Yellow Extinguishant Release surface mounting Call Point, Resettable, with hinged cover & “Extinguishant Release” text
family: Fire Extinguishant Call Points, Abort & Hold Buttons
summary: Resettable Extinguishant Release Call Point with simple ‘RESET’ mechanism.
description: 3/4″Ø preopened conduit entries from top, bottom and the back are provided for extra convenience.
features: Extinguishant Release call point that can be used to remotely trigger the EP203/CON panel’s extinguishant release sequence.
Supplied with a hinged protective cover.
Suitable for Surface or Flush mounting
Consists of ABS plastic operating elements that simulates break glass activation which is instantly reusable with no glass elements to break, lose or incorrectly fit when installing
Thread protection plugs are provided to protect the brass inserts on the base box (when conceal fixing is needed).
3/4"Ø preopened conduit entries from top, bottom and the back are provided for extra convenience.
Colour matching polythene plugs for conduit entries are included.
